maya: Evening coverage swap — I'm out at 23:00 UTC. Leaving a short watchlist and a couple of ops checks. :wave:
aj: thanks! paste the runbooks? :eyes:
maya: runbooks and quick commands below. Summary: encoder-pool has been flapping at low frequency (3 restarts in 6h) — not service impacting yet. prefetch jitter in eu-west noticed after the batching tweak — spikes in median -> watch 95th. kv-prefetch alert noisy on small bursts, mute rather than escalate unless error-rate climbs. Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/prefetch-jitter

maya: watchlist (actions + thresholds)
- encoder-pool: pod restarts seen on encoder-03/04, timeline at 20:12+21:02 UTC. Action: check node memory OOMs before scaling. Escalate only if restart_count>5 in 30m.
- prefetch-jitter (eu-west): 95th latency > 600ms sustained for 10m -> investigate batching config rollback.
- kv-prefetch alert (noisy): firing on short-lived bursts, recommended mute for maintenance windows.

maya: quick mute command if you need it (use sparingly):
```
/alerts mute kv-prefetch-noise --duration 2h --reason "maintenance/ops checks"
```

aj: copying that. If we mute, can we add a lightweight slack webhook to the mute so we still see suppressed counts?

liam: can do — add `--notify-channel #eng-oncall` in the wrapper. I added a small script under infra/tools/alert-mute to annotate mutes.

olga: @maya curious about encoder restarts — do we have image/driver changes deployed tonight?

maya: no image rollouts from runtime team since 19:00 UTC. Kernel/driver changes were done earlier this week; I left notes in the PR: https://git.redwood/runtime/pull/1428. Suggest checking `kubectl describe pod` for OOMKilled or `dmesg` for oom_killer lines before touching scaling.

aj: if we see 5+ restarts I'll leave a pager, otherwise keep as FYI. Also watch the canary rollout we kicked for batching (v2.3.1) — it could surface transient 95th spikes.

oncall-bot: Alert: prefetch-jitter-eu-west fired at 1777777230. Count: 3 spikes over 5m.

maya: noted on the bot. If it's <=3 spikes in 10m, ignore. If it keeps repeating, flip batching back with the canary rollback command: `infra/deploys rollback batching v2.3.1 --canary-only` (requires infra-lead ok).

liam: FYI I pushed a grafana panel with baseline + current for prefetch latencies: https://grafana.redwood/d/xyz/prefetch-latency — helps spot regressions.

olga: thanks — I'll keep an eye on 95th and message if it crosses 700ms for >15m.

sre-rotations: Acknowledged. I'm covering 22:00-02:00 UTC, ping me if you want me to run the mute or the rollback. Otherwise I'll watch the panels and escalate per the thresholds above. :thumbsup:
